user.title: Set up Roy's Net Meter
user.description: Select the entities from your net meter, CT clamps, and inverter that this integration needs. See the README for the full explanation of each.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this net meter setup.
data_description.gen_amp_entity: The sensor reporting your solar inverter's AC output current (A). Compared against the consumption current sensor to decide whether you're importing or exporting.
data_description.con_amp_entity: The sensor reporting the amperage (A) of your home's main incoming line, typically from a CT clamp.
data_description.flow_power_entity: The net real power (W) reported by your net meter, e.g. an ESPHome Home Assistant Glow device.
data_description.flow_energy_entity: The net real energy (kWh) reported by the same net meter.
data_description.gen_power_entity: Your solar inverter's AC output power (W).
data_description.gen_energy_entity: Your solar inverter's total generated energy (kWh).

error.unknown: Could not read one or more of the selected entities. Make sure they all exist and have a value, then try again.
